summary: Waste Connections, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to offer C$700M aggregate principal amount of senior notes in two tranches: C$300M 4.200% notes due 2033 and C$400M 4.550% notes due 2036. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing unsecured debt. Proceeds before expenses are C$298.404M and C$396.844M for the 2033 and 2036 notes, respectively. Interest is semi-annual, with a long first coupon. The issuer may redeem notes under certain conditions. There is an optional change-of-control put at 101%. This is a routine debt offering; no special situation.
